item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Bradenton building collapse forces evacuation
item.description: Emergency teams rushed to 105 15th St. E. on Saturday afternoon to assist facility residents after a building failure. Personnel from the Bradenton Fire Department and Manatee County EMS District Chiefs responded to lead the evacuation effort.
